hero.title: My sessions
hero.introA: Book a trainer-led session in person or live online, then manage it here. All times are Qatar time.
hero.introB: Join optional live clinics with Academy trainers. All times are Qatar time.
hero.level1Done: Level 1 complete. You are eligible to book.
hero.imageAlt: A tour guide talking with visitors in Doha

page.loadError: Your sessions could not be loaded
page.connectionError: The connection to the Academy service failed. Check your network and try again.

mine.heading: Your bookings
mine.emptyBody: Book a session below. Your confirmed seat appears here straight away.

browse.heading: Book a session
browse.intro: Sessions in your programmes, with seats remaining and any prerequisite. A locked session tells you what is missing.
browse.noProgrammesTitle: You are not enrolled in a programme yet
browse.noProgrammesBody: Enrol in a programme to see its sessions here.
browse.noSessionsTitle: No upcoming sessions are open right now
browse.noSessionsBody: New sessions are published by Academy trainers. Check back soon.

bNotice.title: Program B has no required sessions
bNotice.onlyB: Visitor Service Essentials is completed entirely self-paced, so you never need to book a session to finish it.
bNotice.both: Your Program B journey is self-paced and never waits on a session.
bNotice.tail: The optional clinics below add live practice with a trainer. Booking one does not change your completion requirements.
bNotice.tailStandalone: Booking trainer-led sessions is part of Program A, the certification track.

catalogue.noMatchBody: Try another format to see more sessions.

calendar.marked: Marked days have sessions. Dates follow Qatar time.
calendar.emptyBody: Pick a marked day in the calendar, or switch to the list to see every session.

eligibility.offered: A seat is offered to you

policy.title: Cancellation and reschedule policy.
policy.default: Self-service changes until 24 hours before the session. Later changes request admin review.
policy.note: Illustrative demo default, configurable by the Academy.

booking.confirmed: Booking confirmed: {{title}}. It is now in My sessions.
booking.waitlisted: You are number {{position}} on the waitlist for {{title}}.
booking.failed: The booking could not be saved. Try again.
booking.fullNote: This session is full. Join the waitlist: when a seat opens, the first eligible approved learner is offered it for {{hours}} hours, and you will be told here and in your notifications.

myBooking.movedFrom: Moved from {{from}}. Reason: {{reason}} If the new time does not work for you, choose another eligible session.
myBooking.academyCancelled: This session was cancelled by the Academy. {{reason}} Your learning progress is saved. Choose another available session below.
myBooking.youMoved: You moved this booking to another session.
myBooking.within24: Starts within 24 hours. Changes need admin review.
myBooking.leaveFailed: You could not leave the waitlist. Try again.
myBooking.waitlistNote: A waitlisted place is not a booking and is not counted as attending. If a seat opens and you are next, you will be offered it here.

offer.title: A seat is reserved for you
offer.body: A seat opened on this session. Accept it before the offer ends, or it goes to the next learner.
offer.accepted: Seat accepted. Your booking is confirmed.
offer.declined: Offer declined. The seat goes to the next learner.
offer.failed: The answer could not be saved. Try again.
offer.gone: This offer has expired and the seat has gone to the next learner.

cancelDialog.cancelBody: Your seat is released for another learner. You can book another session at any time.
cancelDialog.requestBody: This session starts within 24 hours, so changes need admin review.
cancelDialog.reasonShort: Tell the Academy why you need the change (at least 5 characters).
cancelDialog.cancelled: Booking cancelled. The seat has been released.
cancelDialog.cancelledOffer: Booking cancelled. Seat offer created — demo email and in-app notification added to the notification log.
cancelDialog.already: You have already asked for a change to this booking. The Academy will follow up.
cancelDialog.requested: Request sent for admin review. Your booking stays in place until the Academy replies.
cancelDialog.failed: The change could not be sent. Try again.

moveDialog.title: Reschedule your booking
moveDialog.none: There is no other session in this programme right now. Keep your current booking or check again later.
moveDialog.fullBlocked: Full. Moving needs a confirmed seat.
moveDialog.moved: Booking moved. Your new seat is confirmed and the previous seat was released.
moveDialog.failed: The move could not be saved. Your current seat is kept.

requests.heading: Your requests
requests.intro: Enrolment and external-certificate requests that need Academy approval.
requests.empty: You have no requests at the moment.

next.pending: The Academy is reviewing your request. You do not need to do anything yet.
next.approved: Approved. Your programme is open. Book a session below. A full session puts you on its waitlist.
next.rejected: Fix the issue described above and send a new request.
next.info_requested: Reply with the information the Academy asked for.

requests.requestSent: Request {{code}} sent. It is now Pending review.
requests.requestFailed: The request could not be sent. Try again.
requests.replySent: Reply sent. The request is back in review.
